purpose: dataset suitability for simulator validation; no policy training or physical validation performed
selection_status: candidate review only; final role, selection and scope not agreed

candidates.name: Dogrib Fire 2001 reference case
candidates.role: first Cell2Fire-compatible historical case / sanity check, not independent generalization test
candidates.license_status: repository declares MIT; separate originating Prometheus/Alberta data terms not confirmed
limitations: shared fuel/elevation patch with Firehose Sub20
historical suppression present in case chronology
observation and simulation time windows must be reconciled
663 observed-burn pixels coincide with nonfuel code101; no silent label filtering
full map is incompatible with existing 400-action policy without explicit cropping/scaling design

candidates.name: Canadian Fire Spread Dataset
candidates.role: broader independent historical validation candidate after input preparation
limitations: daily interpolated day-of-burning, not minute-level observed front
reviewed daily table lacks wind direction and is not a complete spatial fuel grid
release history documents beta/topology/points-update caveats; per-event QC required
observed outcomes do not identify counterfactual outcomes under new RL actions

candidates.name: WildfireSpreadTS
candidates.role: alternative for daily spread forecasting; lower priority for current Cell2Fire controller
limitations: US remote-sensing feature stack requires conversion to Canadian FBP simulator inputs

candidates.name: MITRE BurnMD
candidates.role: conditional alternative if SimFire is later selected
